invariants.text: Project.project_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Task.task_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Task.project_id must reference an existing Project.project_id
A task must belong to exactly one project.
The status of a task must be one of the defined task status values.
The priority of a task must be one of the defined priority levels.
A project must have at least one task to be considered active.
When a task is deleted, its associated project is not affected unless the project has no other tasks.
The title of a task must be unique within the project it belongs to.
A project's title must be unique across all projects.
